title: Invertibility of the specified finite quotient support comparison
statement: In the finite-field and ℓ-adic coefficient setting [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], let X,Y be finite type over the algebraic closure of the finite field, f:X→Y separated finite type, and c any compactification. For positive levels 1≤k≤n and a finite Tor constructible K [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] at level n, the specified supportComparison [def-sf-concrete-projection-reduction-data] for the quotient A_n→A_k is an isomorphism. This concerns the canonical scalar-adjunction mate in the chosen ringed proper/open coordinates, with the two scalarIso presentation changes. The schemes structure morphisms need not be separated.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 07A6, 0D6D, 0E48; more-etale.tex Tags 0GL1 and 0GL6. Concrete proper/open argument of fix-prop-projection-formula, proof sentence 2.

proof.text: Finite Tor constructibility is preserved by the actual scalar quotient input. Apply the canonical intrinsic finite compact-support coefficient theorem.

Identify the constant-ring proper/open presentation with the intrinsic one using the unit-preserving open comparison and separately derived canonical direct-image comparison. Their restriction squares agree by their ordinary unit and K-injective normalizations. Scalar-adjunction uniqueness identifies the resulting invertible map with PurCompactSupport.comparison. The two scalarIso factors are invertible.

proof_origin.place: Concrete finite coefficient-reduction square, proof sentence 2; the component argument recorded above.

theorem supportComparison_quotient_isIso
    (m : Models.{u}) (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (X Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of D.k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.left] [QuasiCompact f.left]
    (c : Compactification f.left)
    (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X.left (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n))
    (hK : finiteTorConstructible C.l E n hn X.left K) :
    IsIso (supportComparison m (quotient C.l E hkn) c K)
